description: This file defines a set of React components for a custom Select UI element, wrapping Radix UI primitives and adding styling and structure.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Main wrapper component for the select, rendering Radix UI Root.

methods.name: SelectTrigger
methods.description: Component for the trigger button that opens the select menu.

methods.name: SelectContent
methods.description: Component rendering the dropdown content of the select.

methods.name: SelectLabel
methods.description: Component for labeling sections within the select.

methods.name: SelectItem
methods.description: Component representing an individual selectable item.

methods.name: SelectSeparator
methods.description: Component for separating groups of items.

methods.name: SelectScrollUpButton
methods.description: Button to scroll up in the dropdown list.

methods.name: SelectScrollDownButton
methods.description: Button to scroll down in the dropdown list.
